review_protocol: Drafted single-pass by a `w` session on 2026-09-22 without the /ai-design grill or a taskplan, then matured in review round 1 by a `d` session the same day. Scope was re-centred onto the silent model_path/model_name break, the missing canonical sections were written, taskplan.json was authored and validated, and a cross-family confront was dispatched. summary: Make the already-built KBDLHorizyn job type safe to run. Three changes: (1) fix a SILENT model-identity bug -- KBDL's adapter calls ProtT5Utils(model_name=...) while KBUtilLib's constructor takes model_path=, and BaseUtils absorbs unknown kwargs via setattr, so the operator's configured KBDL_PROT_T5_MODEL is discarded with no error and the hardcoded default checkpoint is used instead; (2) add JOB_TYPE_HORIZYN + submit_horizyn to the KBUtilLib KBDL client; (3) declare a prott5 optional-dependency extra and validate the embedding path numerically against the 2026-09-21 eval baseline (44.6/64.0/66.3% recall), pinned to max_residues=1000 to match how that baseline was measured.
superseded_claims: Draft claimed ProtT5Utils 'does not exist on any KBUtilLib branch'. FALSE -- merged 2026-09-13 as 215625c with full tests; the drafting session read a clone 116 commits behind origin/main.

Draft's pinned decision 'the consumer wins, use model_name' is resolved the other way: model_path is canonical (the library merged first and is tested/documented against it) and the KBDL call site is corrected. See Q1.

Draft's D4 ('truncation belongs to the caller, do not implement it here') contradicted the merged module, which truncates at max_residues and reports truncated_ids. Superseded by Q5: keep it, and pass the service's cap through explicitly.
Draft claimed the client 'enumerates exactly five job types'. There are nine constants and eight submit_* methods, and the two docstring edits the draft prescribed target text that does not exist.
Draft's numeric acceptance could not have passed as written: the baseline was measured at MAX_RESIDUES=1000 while the module and service default to 5000. See Q4.

tasks.notes: PASS. Run 2026-09-24 by Maestro task-e5b3a15f; report committed at KBDLJobRunningPrototype agent-io/research/prott5-utils-numeric-acceptance.md (14adfd2, corrected cbbd414) with the variant script run_eval_prott5utils.py beside run_eval.py. recall@1/@5/@10 = 0.4457/0.6400/0.6629 (78/112/116 of 175) vs baseline 0.446/0.640/0.663; abs deltas 0.0003/0.0000/0.0001, all <= 0.02. KEY NUANCE from cbbd414: the paths are CLOSE, NOT equivalent -- all 175 top-1 scores differ (4.17e-07..4.10e-04) and 17 proteins flipped rank, but every flip is in the deep tail (min rank 191) so zero crossed the k=1/5/10 boundaries. Recall reproduces exactly because no drift landed near a decision boundary, not because nothing moved -- a future eval set with a protein at rank 10/11 could flip a figure with neither path being wrong. Independently re-run 2026-09-26 by miles session 0fb3ff0e, which reproduced the same three figures and hit counts.
